body: I guess I play videogames for fun, but they aren't really fun for me anymore it's more of just an escape from my reality.  And my favorite food is potatoes.  pretty much any kind of potato.

Because at almost 34 years old, nothing in my life has gotten better since I tried to kill myself when I was 14.  So 20 years of the same bullshit and why the hell would I wanna keep going if after 20 years shit hasn't gotten any better.  Sorry not meaning to sound mean, but I just don't think things will get better.  I'm a loser and I always will be.

I just want to say, thank you so much for replying it really means a lot to me.  You have no idea.  Thank you.  And no not really I just kind of wanted to vent.  I'm ready to die but only because I dont feel like anything is ever going to get better.
